title_vi: Would you like … ? / I’d like … (Bạn có muốn … ? / Tôi muốn …)
theory_html:
A. Would you like … ? = Do you want … ?

A. Would you like … ? = Bạn có muốn … ?

We use Would you like … ? to offer things:

Dùng Would you like … ? để mời ai cái gì:

  • A: Would you like some coffee? B: No, thank you.

    A: Bạn có muốn uống cà phê không? B: Không, cảm ơn.

  • A: Would you like a chocolate? B: Yes, please.

    A: Bạn ăn sô-cô-la không? B: Vâng, cảm ơn.

  • A: What would you like, tea or coffee? B: Tea, please.

    A: Bạn muốn uống gì, trà hay cà phê? B: Trà ạ.

We use Would you like to … ? to invite somebody:

Dùng Would you like to … ? để mời ai làm gì:

  • Would you like to go for a walk?

    Bạn có muốn đi dạo không?

  • A: Would you like to eat with us on Sunday? B: Yes, I’d love to. (= I would love to eat with you)

    A: Bạn có muốn ăn cùng chúng tôi vào Chủ nhật không? B: Có, tôi rất muốn.

  • What would you like to do this evening?

    Tối nay bạn muốn làm gì?

B. I’d like … = a polite way to say ‘I want’

B. I’d like … = cách nói lịch sự của ‘I want’

I’d like … is a polite way to say ‘I want’. I’d like = I would like:

I’d like … là cách nói lịch sự của ‘I want’ (tôi muốn). I’d like = I would like:

  • I’m thirsty. I’d like a drink.

    Tôi khát. Tôi muốn uống gì đó.

  • (in a tourist office) I’d like some information about hotels, please.

    (ở văn phòng du lịch) Tôi muốn biết thông tin về khách sạn.

  • I’m feeling tired. I’d like to stay at home this evening.

    Tôi thấy mệt. Tối nay tôi muốn ở nhà.

C. Would you like … ? and Do you like … ?

C. Would you like … ? và Do you like … ?

Do you like tea? = Do you think tea is nice? / Would you like some tea? = Do you want some tea?

Do you like tea? = Bạn có thích trà không (nói chung)? / Would you like some tea? = Bạn có muốn uống trà (bây giờ) không?

Would you like … ? / I’d like …Do you like … ? / I like …
A: Would you like to go to the cinema tonight? (= do you want to go tonight?) B: Yes, I’d love to.A: Do you like going to the cinema? (in general) B: Yes, I go to the cinema a lot.
I’d like an orange, please. (= can I have an orange?)I like oranges. (in general)
What would you like to do next weekend?What do you like to do at weekends?

mcq.question: A: ___ some coffee? B: No, thank you.
mcq.full: A: Would you like some coffee? B: No, thank you.
mcq.vi: A: Bạn có muốn uống cà phê không? B: Không, cảm ơn.
mcq.expl:
Would you like …? = Do you want …? (offering); Would you like to …? = inviting.
Would you like …? = Bạn có muốn …? (mời); Would you like to …? = mời làm gì.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Mời → Would you like.
mcq.key: A: ___ some coffee? B: No, thank you.|Would you like

mcq.question: You want to play tennis tomorrow. You say to Sue: ___ tennis tomorrow?
mcq.full: You want to play tennis tomorrow. You say to Sue: Would you like to play tennis tomorrow?
mcq.vi: Bạn muốn chơi quần vợt ngày mai. Bạn nói với Sue: Bạn có muốn chơi quần vợt ngày mai không?
mcq.expl:
Would you like …? = Do you want …? (offering); Would you like to …? = inviting.
Would you like …? = Bạn có muốn …? (mời); Would you like to …? = mời làm gì.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Mời → Would you like to play.
mcq.key: You want to play tennis tomorrow. You say to Sue: ___ tennis tomorrow?|Would you like to play

mcq.expl:
Would you like …? = Do you want …? (offering); Would you like to …? = inviting.
Would you like …? = Bạn có muốn …? (mời); Would you like to …? = mời làm gì.

mcq.question: It’s raining and Sue doesn’t have an umbrella. ___ my umbrella?
mcq.full: It’s raining and Sue doesn’t have an umbrella. Would you like to borrow my umbrella?
mcq.vi: Trời mưa và Sue không có ô. Bạn có muốn mượn ô của tôi không?
mcq.expl:
Would you like …? = Do you want …? (offering); Would you like to …? = inviting.
Would you like …? = Bạn có muốn …? (mời); Would you like to …? = mời làm gì.
Điểm ngữ pháp: borrow (mượn) – không phải lend.
mcq.key: It’s raining and Sue doesn’t have an umbrella. ___ my umbrella?|Would you like to borrow

mcq.question: ‘___ bananas?’ ‘Yes, I love them.’
mcq.full: ‘Do you like bananas?’ ‘Yes, I love them.’
mcq.vi: ‘Bạn có thích chuối không?’ ‘Có, tôi rất thích.’
mcq.expl:
Do you like …? / I like … = in general (do you think it is nice?).
Do you like …? / I like … = nói chung (bạn có thấy thích không?).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Nói chung → Do you like.
mcq.key: ‘___ bananas?’ ‘Yes, I love them.’|Do you like
